pulses.name: An Overview of The Gentlemen's TTPs
pulses.description: This intelligence report provides a comprehensive analysis of The Gentlemen, a ransomware group known for its sophisticated tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). The group exploits vulnerabilities in FortiOS/FortiProxy, maintains a database of compromised devices, and employs advanced defense evasion techniques.
